title.narrative: Strengthening freedom of expression & Safety of Journalists in Lebanon & Palesti

description.narrative: UNESCO will support national stakeholders in strengthening capacities to protect journalists and media workers operating in conflict, crisis, and emergency contexts. The activity will promote the implementation of the UN Plan of Action on the Safety of Journalists and the Issue of Impunity through a multi-stakeholder approach involving media institutions, journalists' syndicates, security forces, judicial actors, civil society organizations, and relevant government entities. Special attention will be given to the protection of journalists covering armed conflict, political unrest, humanitarian emergencies, elections, and other high-risk situations, as well as to addressing online violence and gender-specific threats faced by women journalists.
